text:
Maya: Hey team — quick thought: Friday courtyard pancake picnic + mini pet parade? Bring pets, pancake toppings, and something to sit on. Thinking 12:30. Who's in? 🥞🐶🐱

Sam: Love it — count me in. I can bring a small griddle and vegan batter (GF option). :grin:

Jules: Can we do a 'no loud toys' rule? Luna gets anxious around squeakers.

Devon: I'm down. I'll bring maple syrup and a foldable table. Also happy to grab extra plates.

OpsBot: Reminder: courtyard reservation currently free — if you need more than 3 tables, please file a request with `#facilities`.

Lina: I'm remote that day but can drop off pancake batter at reception around 11:30. Label it "Lina - GF batter."

Ben: Allergies note: severe peanut allergy. Please label anything with nut toppings.

Anya: Could we do a tiny 'best pet costume' vote? Winner gets two movie vouchers 🍿

Maya: Love the costume idea. Quick poll: 12:30 or 1:00? React :one: for 12:30, :two: for 1:00. Also react :white_check_mark: if you're bringing a pet.

Sam: :one: :white_check_mark: (bringing Flapjack the corgi)

Jules: :one: (no pet, bringing jam + berries)

Devon: :two: — slight calendar conflict but can probably shuffle. :white_check_mark: (bringing mini syrup bottles)

Lina: :one: — batter dropoff confirmed.

Ben: :one: — I'll bring nut-free granola and labeled jars.

Priya: Kids okay? My niece might tag along.

Maya: Kids welcome — we'll keep things low-key.

Maya: Looks like 12:30 is winning. I'll reserve officially and make a tiny Google form for dietary restrictions + whether you're bringing a pet.

OpsBot: Form draft posted: https://forms.gle/example (placeholder). Final headcount reactions requested by Thu 6pm.

Maya: Awesome — see you Friday!
